title: The Forminator Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited File Deletion in all versions up… (CVE-2026-5461)
description: The Forminator Forms plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 1.55.0.2 contains a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary non-PHP files within the wp-content/uploads/ directory. This occurs because the plugin accepts arbitrary upload field metadata from POST requests in draft submissions without proper validation, which can be exploited via the previous_draft_id parameter referencing a manipulated draft.
